source: Reference spine r2 (batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature, decisions D6 and D13): CoolProp alpha0 (Setzmann and Wagner 1991) from the triple point to 425 K, the GERG-2008 ideal-gas function (Jaeschke and Schley 1995) from 425 to 1200 K (Cp step at the join +0.0058 %); methane's ideal gas is not available above 1200 K; ATcT 1.220 formation enthalpy; CEA standard entropy (R = 8.314510). Built by tools/spine-join-measurement/build-spine-records.mjs. r2 (P3 WP9a) replaces the NASA CEA (Gurvich 1991) segments above 375 K of r1. r3 (batch 2026-11-04-open-thermo-data, O2): the |CEA - JANAF| entropy uncertainty removed.

formation_enthalpy.source: ATcT 1.220 (74-82-8*0) as carried in CoolProp master 9b35f538 INFO.STANDARD_STATE

standard_entropy.source: NASA CEA thermo.inp CH4 (g 8/99) polynomial at 298.15 K and 1e5 Pa with R = 8.314510 (the polynomial is not a segment of this record); no uncertainty: CEA states none (the |CEA - JANAF| estimate of the earlier revision was removed, batch 2026-11-04-open-thermo-data, O2)

segments.source: CoolProp Methane.json EOS[0].alpha0 (revision ae81610e, MIT; Setzmann-JPCRD-1991); lead and enthalpy-entropy offset terms omitted (constants only)

GERG-2008 ideal-gas part of methane (Kunz and Wagner 2012, J. Chem. Eng. Data 57, 3032; the cp0 equation of Jaeschke and Schley 1995, Int. J. Thermophys. 16, 1381) as NIST's AGA8 GERG2008.cpp codes it (github.com/usnistgov/AGA8): n0i[1][3..7] (line 1256) and th0i[1][4..7] (line 1277) verbatim with R* = Rs = 8.31451 (line 666); log_tau a = n0i[1][3] - 1; the ln sinh terms (j = 4, 6) as planck_einstein with t = 2 th0i, the ln cosh terms (j = 5, 7) as planck_einstein_cosh with t = th0i; reducing temperature 1 K, so t is in K as GERG2008.cpp evaluates th0i/T; n0i[1][1..2] only fix h and s at GERG's reference state and are not carried

coverage.evidence: P3 WP9a ReferenceSpineTest (decision D13): the Setzmann-Wagner segment equals the Java Helmholtz oracle to 1e-9 and the GERG-2008 segment a transcription of GERG2008.cpp; against the ideal-gas Cp of the ExoMol MM line list (a test holdout, P3_REFERENCES_WP8_WP10.md part B; nothing derived from it is bundled) the spine's Cp is within 0.13 % from 300 to 1200 K (D7 target 0.2 %; the reference's own declared error grows to -0.10/+0.62 % at 1200 K) and h(T) - h(298.15) within 8 J/mol; unavailable above 1200 K
